title: The Final Signal
author: Silas Ashgrove
blurb: Silas Crane, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
